prompt: Refactor a poorly-written Angular component to follow the style guide: fix selector naming, remove standalone:true, replace *ngIf/*ngFor with @if/@for, replace ngClass with class binding, use inject() instead of constructor DI, add OnPush, remove any types.

assertions.name: fixes_selector
assertions.description: Changes PascalCase selector to kebab-case with prefix (e.g., app-user-list)

assertions.name: uses_inject
assertions.description: Replaces constructor(private http: HttpClient) with inject(HttpClient)

assertions.name: removes_any
assertions.description: Replaces any types with proper interfaces/types
